senses.en: a single part or quantity within a larger whole
a device or separate part of a machine
a group organised for a particular task

ex.en: We finished the first unit before our lunch break.
ex.zh: 我们在午休前学完了第一个单元。

ex.en: Each unit of the course introduces practical skills that students can apply in the workplace.
ex.zh: 这门课程的每个单元都介绍学生可以在工作中运用的实用技能。

col: a unit of measurement｜计量单位
an intensive care unit｜重症监护病房
tip: 表示计量单位时常用a unit of，后接所计量的事物。

senses.en: A preparatory unit at the start of the textbook.

ex.en: We learn greetings in the starter units.
ex.zh: 我们在过渡单元里学习打招呼。

ex.en: The starter unit is easy and fun.
ex.zh: 过渡单元简单又有趣。

senses.en: A distinct part of something larger.
A surface or thin piece exposed by cutting through something.
To divide something into parts or cut it into slices.

ex.en: You'll find fresh bread in the bakery section.
ex.zh: 你可以在烘焙区找到新鲜面包。

ex.en: The final section of the report examines how urban design can encourage healthier lifestyles.
ex.zh: 报告的最后一部分探讨了城市设计如何促进更健康的生活方式。

tip: section可指文章章节，也可指商店等场所的区域。

senses.en: to welcome someone or say hello
to become noticeable when someone arrives or looks

ex.en: Our neighbours greeted us warmly when we moved in.
ex.zh: 我们搬来时，邻居们热情地向我们打招呼。

ex.en: Visitors are greeted by trained volunteers who explain the museum's collection and help them find their way.
ex.zh: 受过培训的志愿者迎接参观者，介绍博物馆的藏品并为他们指路。

col: greet someone warmly｜热情地问候某人
greet someone with a smile｜微笑着迎接某人
be greeted by｜受到迎接；首先看到
tip: greet直接接人；表示向某人问好不加to。

senses.en: Every individual member of a group, considered separately.
Every person or thing in a group, taken separately.
For every individual person or thing.

ex.en: Each child carried a small basket into the garden.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都提着一个小篮子走进花园。

ex.en: Each household can reduce its environmental impact by conserving water and choosing products with less packaging.
ex.zh: 每个家庭都可以通过节约用水和选择包装较少的产品来减少对环境的影响。

tip: each后接单数名词；each of后接复数名词或代词。

senses.en: Different from or additional to those already mentioned.
A remaining or different person or thing.

ex.en: This shoe fits, but where is the other one?
ex.zh: 这只鞋合脚，但另一只在哪里？

ex.en: Schools should teach practical skills alongside other subjects to prepare students for the demands of adult life.
ex.zh: 学校应在教授其他科目的同时传授实用技能，让学生为成年生活的要求做好准备。

col: on the other hand｜另一方面
tip: other后接名词；others独立使用；两者中另一个用the other。

senses.en: Each one to the other; reciprocally.

ex.en: We help each other with English.
ex.zh: 我们在英语学习上互相帮助。

ex.en: They look at each other and laugh.
ex.zh: 他们互相看着对方，笑了起来。

tip: 表示“互相”，两个人或多个人之间都可用。

senses.en: Used to show surprise or understanding.

ex.en: Oh, I see. Thank you!
ex.zh: 哦，我明白了。谢谢你！

ex.en: Oh! Your bag is on the desk.
ex.zh: 哦！你的书包在课桌上。

senses.en: Every person in a group, or all people.

ex.en: Everyone brought a dish to share at the picnic.
ex.zh: 每个人都带了一道菜，在野餐时一起分享。

ex.en: Public libraries should ensure that everyone can access reliable information, regardless of income or educational background.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆应确保每个人都能获取可靠信息，不论收入或教育背景如何。

tip: everyone接单数谓语；every one强调逐个。

senses.en: To begin doing something or cause something to begin.
To make a machine operate, or begin operating.
The moment or place where something begins.

ex.en: We started cooking dinner as soon as we got home.
ex.zh: 我们一到家就开始做晚饭。

ex.en: Schools should start teaching financial skills early so that young people can make informed decisions about money.
ex.zh: 学校应尽早开始教授理财技能，让年轻人能在充分了解情况后作出财务决定。

col: at the start of｜在……开始时
make a fresh start｜重新开始
tip: start doing与start to do通常都可表示开始做某事。

senses.en: A talk in which people exchange ideas, feelings, or information.

ex.en: We had a friendly conversation while waiting for the bus.
ex.zh: 等公交车时，我们友好地聊了一会儿。

ex.en: Regular conversation with fluent speakers helps language learners develop confidence and improve their listening skills.
ex.zh: 经常与语言流利的人交谈有助于语言学习者建立信心并提高听力。

tip: 与某人谈某事：have a conversation with某人about某事。

senses.en: To write or say the letters of a word in order.
A period during which a particular condition or activity continues.
Words or magic believed to have special powers.

ex.en: Could you spell your surname slowly for me, please?
ex.zh: 请你把姓氏慢慢拼给我听，好吗？

ex.en: A prolonged spell of dry weather can reduce crop yields and increase pressure on local water supplies.
ex.zh: 持续的干旱天气会降低农作物产量，并加大当地供水压力。

col: a spell of illness｜一段患病期
tip: 过去式及过去分词英式可用spelt或spelled。

senses.en: a hollow metal object that rings when struck
the ringing sound made by a bell

ex.en: The bicycle bell rang as a cyclist approached.
ex.zh: 一位骑车人靠近时，自行车铃响了。

ex.en: In many schools, a bell marks the beginning and end of each lesson.
ex.zh: 在许多学校，铃声标志着每节课的开始和结束。

tip: ring a bell也可表示“听着耳熟；似曾相识”。

senses.en: A girl's name.

ex.en: Helen is my classmate.
ex.zh: 海伦是我的同班同学。

ex.en: Good morning, Helen!
ex.zh: 早上好，海伦！

senses.en: A girl's name.

ex.en: Ella likes reading books.
ex.zh: 埃拉喜欢看书。

ex.en: This is my friend Ella.
ex.zh: 这是我的朋友埃拉。

senses.en: A girl's name.

ex.en: Emma is from the UK.
ex.zh: 埃玛来自英国。

ex.en: I play with Emma after school.
ex.zh: 放学后我和埃玛一起玩。

senses.en: A boy's name.

ex.en: Peter is eleven years old.
ex.zh: 彼得十一岁。

ex.en: Can Peter spell his name?
ex.zh: 彼得会拼写自己的名字吗？

senses.en: Having the colour of chocolate or dark wood.
The colour of chocolate or dark wood.
To become brown, or make food brown through cooking.

ex.en: A small brown dog was sleeping beside the door.
ex.zh: 一只棕色的小狗正在门边睡觉。

ex.en: During dry periods, grass often turns brown as plants conserve water and reduce their growth.
ex.zh: 在干旱时期，植物为了保存水分会减缓生长，草也常因此变成褐色。

tip: brown作动词常用于烹饪，指把食物煎或烤至褐色。

senses.en: The People's Republic of China.

ex.en: The PRC was founded in 1949.
ex.zh: 中华人民共和国成立于1949年。

ex.en: Beijing is the capital of the PRC.
ex.zh: 北京是中华人民共和国的首都。

tip: PRC 是 People's Republic of China 的缩写。

senses.en: The People's Liberation Army of China.

ex.en: The PLA helps people in times of danger.
ex.zh: 中国人民解放军在危险时刻帮助人民。

ex.en: PLA Day is on 1st August.
ex.zh: 建军节是8月1日。

senses.en: Virtual reality; a computer world you feel inside.

ex.en: We use VR glasses in science class.
ex.zh: 我们在科学课上使用VR眼镜。

ex.en: VR games are very exciting.
ex.zh: VR游戏非常刺激。

tip: VR 是 virtual reality 的缩写。

senses.en: The World Health Organization.

ex.en: The WHO works for people's health all over the world.
ex.zh: 世界卫生组织为全世界人民的健康而工作。

ex.en: Doctors from the WHO help in many countries.
ex.zh: 世界卫生组织的医生在许多国家提供帮助。

tip: 注意与疑问词 who（谁）区分：这里是缩略词，要大写。

senses.en: The United Nations.

ex.en: China is a member of the UN.
ex.zh: 中国是联合国的一员。

ex.en: The UN works for world peace.
ex.zh: 联合国致力于世界和平。

tip: UN 是 United Nations 的缩写。

senses.en: A family name.

ex.en: Ms Miller is our English teacher.
ex.zh: 米勒女士是我们的英语老师。

ex.en: His full name is Peter Miller.
ex.zh: 他的全名是彼得·米勒。

senses.en: A narrow-necked container for liquids, or the amount it holds.
To put a liquid into bottles for storage or sale.

ex.en: She filled her water bottle before leaving the house.
ex.zh: 她出门前把水瓶装满了。

ex.en: Choosing a reusable bottle instead of disposable plastic containers can help reduce waste in cities.
ex.zh: 选择可重复使用的瓶子而非一次性塑料容器，有助于减少城市垃圾。

col: reusable bottle｜可重复使用的瓶子
tip: a bottle of water是一瓶水；water bottle是水瓶。

senses.en: A small object used to remove pencil marks.

ex.en: I borrowed an eraser to correct my pencil drawing.
ex.zh: 我借了一块橡皮擦来修改铅笔画。

ex.en: Providing basic classroom supplies, including pencils and erasers, helps ensure that all children can participate in lessons.
ex.zh: 提供铅笔和橡皮擦等基本课堂用品，有助于确保所有孩子都能参与课堂学习。

tip: eraser常用于美式英语；英式英语常说rubber。

senses.en: An object shaped to open or close a particular lock.
Something essential for understanding or achieving something.
Extremely important to a situation or its outcome.

ex.en: I left my house key in my coat pocket.
ex.zh: 我把家门钥匙放在外套口袋里了。

ex.en: Access to reliable information is key to helping consumers make informed decisions about their health.
ex.zh: 获取可靠信息是帮助消费者就自身健康作出明智决定的关键。

col: the key to success｜成功的关键
play a key role｜发挥关键作用
tip: the key to中to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: an object whose name is unknown or not specified
an action, event, fact, or situation
possessions or equipment, usually referred to in the plural

ex.en: Could you move that heavy thing off my chair?
ex.zh: 你能把那个沉东西从我的椅子上搬走吗？

ex.en: One important thing governments can do is ensure that affordable housing is available near public transport.
ex.zh: 政府可以做的一件重要事情，是确保公共交通附近有可负担的住房。

col: the right thing to do｜正确的做法
first thing in the morning｜早晨第一件事
one thing at a time｜一次一件事
tip: thing很笼统；正式写作尽量换成具体名词。

senses.en: To require something because it is necessary or important
Something necessary or the condition of requiring it
A situation in which essential things are lacking

ex.en: These plants need more water during hot weather.
ex.zh: 天气炎热时，这些植物需要更多的水。

ex.en: Cities need to improve public transport if they want to reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 城市若想减少人们对私家车的依赖，就需要改善公共交通。

col: need to do something｜需要做某事
meet basic needs｜满足基本需求
tip: need to do表需要做；need doing表需要被做。

senses.en: A polite answer to 'Thank you'.

ex.en: —Thank you for your help. —You're welcome.
ex.zh: ——谢谢你的帮助。——别客气。

ex.en: —Thanks a lot! —You're welcome.
ex.zh: ——太感谢了！——不用谢。

tip: 别人道谢时的固定回答。

senses.en: Enjoyment or pleasure from an activity or experience.
Enjoyable and entertaining.

ex.en: We had so much fun building sandcastles together yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们一起堆沙堡，玩得特别开心。

ex.en: Making physical activity fun can encourage children to exercise regularly and develop healthier habits throughout their lives.
ex.zh: 让体育活动充满乐趣，可以鼓励儿童经常锻炼，并养成终身受益的健康习惯。

tip: fun作名词不可数；funny多指好笑的或奇怪的。

senses.en: An outdoor area beside a building, often enclosed.
A unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 metres.

ex.en: Our dog chased a yellow ball across the yard.
ex.zh: 我们的狗追着一个黄色的球跑过院子。

ex.en: Converting an unused school yard into a garden can provide valuable outdoor learning opportunities for urban children.
ex.zh: 把闲置的校园庭院改成花园，可以为城市儿童提供宝贵的户外学习机会。

col: a yard of fabric｜一码布料
tip: 美式yard可指住宅草坪庭院；英式多用garden。

senses.en: A long, usually orange root vegetable.
A reward offered to encourage someone to do something.

ex.en: She sliced a carrot and added it to the soup.
ex.zh: 她把一根胡萝卜切片，放进汤里。

ex.en: Governments can use tax reductions as a carrot to encourage businesses to invest in renewable energy.
ex.zh: 政府可以用减税作为激励，鼓励企业投资可再生能源。

tip: 比喻奖励或诱因；carrot and stick指奖惩并用。

senses.en: A large waterbird with a long neck and webbed feet.
Meat from a goose, eaten as food.

ex.en: A white goose waddled across the path towards us.
ex.zh: 一只白鹅摇摇摆摆地穿过小路，朝我们走来。

ex.en: Protecting wetlands provides essential feeding grounds for wild geese and many other migratory birds.
ex.zh: 保护湿地能为野鹅及许多其他候鸟提供重要的觅食地。

tip: 复数为geese；表示鹅肉时不可数。

senses.en: to find how many things there are
to matter or have an important effect
the act of counting, or the total found

ex.en: Please count the plates before our guests arrive.
ex.zh: 请在客人到来之前数一下盘子。

ex.en: When evaluating educational success, students' confidence and creativity should count as much as examination results.
ex.zh: 评估教育成效时，学生的自信和创造力应与考试成绩同样重要。

col: lose count｜数不清；忘记数到哪里
every minute counts｜每分钟都很重要
tip: count on意为依靠；count作“重要”时不及物。

senses.en: one more, or a different one
one more person or thing, or a different one

ex.en: This cup is cracked, so please bring me another.
ex.zh: 这个杯子裂了，请再给我拿一个。

ex.en: Another reason to invest in public transport is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通的另一个理由是，它有望减少城市空气污染。

tip: 通常接单数名词；another two days表示再两天。

senses.en: In addition to or different from someone or something mentioned
Used after or to introduce an alternative or consequence

ex.en: Would you like anything else with your soup?
ex.zh: 除了汤，你还想要点别的吗？

ex.en: Governments must improve public transport, or else growing traffic congestion may undermine the economic benefits of urban development.
ex.zh: 政府必须改善公共交通，否则日益严重的交通拥堵可能削弱城市发展带来的经济效益。

tip: 放在不定代词或疑问词后，如someone else。

senses.en: A round shape whose edge is equally distant from its centre.
A group of people connected by friendship or shared interests.
To move around something or draw a ring around it.

ex.en: The children sat in a circle on the grass.
ex.zh: 孩子们在草地上围坐成一圈。

ex.en: Joining community activities can help older adults expand their social circle and reduce feelings of isolation.
ex.zh: 参加社区活动可以帮助老年人扩大社交圈，减少孤独感。

tip: circle是圆或圆圈；cycle才常指循环或周期。

senses.en: To turn your eyes towards something.

ex.en: Look at the blackboard, please.
ex.zh: 请看黑板。

ex.en: Look at those geese in the yard!
ex.zh: 看院子里的那些鹅！

tip: look at 后面接看的对象。

senses.en: To become friends with someone.

ex.en: I want to make friends with my new classmates.
ex.zh: 我想和新同学交朋友。

ex.en: It is easy to make friends at school.
ex.zh: 在学校里很容易交到朋友。

col: make friends with sb.｜和某人交朋友

senses.en: To learn about someone or something and become familiar.

ex.en: Let me get to know my new school first.
ex.zh: 先让我了解一下我的新学校。

ex.en: We get to know each other in class.
ex.zh: 我们在课堂上互相认识。

senses.en: Containing as much as possible, with no space left.
Including everything, with nothing missing.
Having eaten enough and not wanting more food.

ex.en: The basket is full, so we need another one.
ex.zh: 篮子已经满了，我们得再拿一个。

ex.en: Governments should publish the full results of environmental studies so that citizens can make informed decisions.
ex.zh: 政府应公布环境研究的完整结果，以便公民作出知情决策。

tip: full of表示“充满”；注意full与fool发音不同。

senses.en: A person's whole name, first name and family name.

ex.en: What is your full name?
ex.zh: 你的全名是什么？

ex.en: Please write your full name on the paper.
ex.zh: 请在纸上写下你的全名。

senses.en: a mark showing achievement, or a level of quality
a school year level, especially in the American system
to assess work or sort things by quality

ex.en: I got a good grade on my science project.
ex.zh: 我的科学课项目得了个好成绩。

ex.en: Teachers should grade assignments consistently so that students understand how their performance is assessed across different subjects.
ex.zh: 教师应按一致的标准给作业评分，让学生了解不同学科如何评估他们的表现。

col: get a good grade｜取得好成绩
tip: 表示年级时多用于美式英语；英式英语常用year。

senses.en: The family name, the last part of a person's name.

ex.en: My last name is Li.
ex.zh: 我姓李。

ex.en: Her last name is Green.
ex.zh: 她的姓是格林。

tip: 英语姓名中，last name 是姓，first name 是名。

senses.en: Someone who studies in the same class as you.

ex.en: My classmate lent me a pencil before the lesson.
ex.zh: 上课前，我的同班同学借给我一支铅笔。

ex.en: Working with classmates on group projects can help students develop communication and problem-solving skills.
ex.zh: 与同班同学合作完成小组项目可以帮助学生培养沟通和解决问题的能力。

col: a former classmate｜以前的同班同学
help a classmate｜帮助同班同学
tip: classmate指同班同学，schoolmate指同校同学。

senses.en: The teacher who is in charge of a class.

ex.en: Ms Gao is our class teacher.
ex.zh: 高老师是我们的班主任。

ex.en: Our class teacher is kind to us.
ex.zh: 我们的班主任对我们很好。

senses.en: The name given to a person, used by family and friends.

ex.en: His first name is Tom.
ex.zh: 他的名字是汤姆。

ex.en: Please tell me your first name.
ex.zh: 请告诉我你的名字。

senses.en: Something incorrect that you do, say, or believe.
To wrongly identify someone or understand something incorrectly.

ex.en: I took your umbrella by mistake this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我误拿了你的伞。

ex.en: Teachers should encourage students to learn from mistakes rather than feel ashamed of making them.
ex.zh: 教师应鼓励学生从错误中学习，而不是因为犯错而感到羞愧。

col: learn from mistakes｜从错误中学习
mistake A for B｜把A误认成B
tip: 说make a mistake，不说do；动词过去式为mistook。

senses.en: An area of land governed as an independent political unit.
Land outside towns and cities, often with farms and villages.
A popular music style rooted in rural American traditions.

ex.en: She hopes to visit another country next summer.
ex.zh: 她希望明年夏天去另一个国家旅行。

ex.en: Each country should develop energy policies that reflect its natural resources and long-term environmental goals.
ex.zh: 各国都应根据本国自然资源和长期环境目标制定能源政策。

col: live in the country｜住在乡下
tip: 表示“乡下”常用 the country，与国家义区分。

senses.en: Exactly alike, or referring to one particular thing rather than another.
The very thing already mentioned, or something exactly like it.

ex.en: We take the same bus to school every morning.
ex.zh: 我们每天早上乘同一班公交车上学。

ex.en: Students from different backgrounds should have the same opportunities to access high-quality education and develop their talents.
ex.zh: 不同背景的学生应享有同样的机会，接受优质教育并发展自己的才能。

tip: 通常用the same；比较时用the same as。

senses.en: One of two children born to the same mother together.
Forming a matching pair, or relating to twins.

ex.en: My twin and I share a love of swimming.
ex.zh: 我的双胞胎手足和我都喜欢游泳。

ex.en: Studies involving identical twins help researchers understand how genes and environment influence human development.
ex.zh: 涉及同卵双胞胎的研究有助于研究人员了解基因和环境如何影响人的发育。

tip: a twin指双胞胎中的一人；twins指两人。

senses.en: referring to two people or things together
the two people or things already mentioned

ex.en: Both windows were open, letting in the cool breeze.
ex.zh: 两扇窗户都开着，凉风吹了进来。

ex.en: Both governments and individuals have a responsibility to reduce waste and protect natural resources.
ex.zh: 政府和个人都有责任减少浪费并保护自然资源。

tip: both指两者；both A and B作主语用复数谓语。

senses.en: A group of musicians who perform together.
A narrow strip or ring of material or colour.
A range of frequencies, values, or levels within a system.

ex.en: My sister plays the drums in a local band.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在当地一支乐队里打鼓。

ex.en: Live bands at community festivals can attract visitors and create opportunities for local businesses.
ex.zh: 社区节庆中的现场乐队演出能吸引游客，并为当地商家创造机会。

tip: IELTS中的band指成绩等级，不是乐队。

senses.en: A deep container used for cooking food.
A container used for plants, storage, or serving drinks.
To put a plant into a container with soil.

ex.en: The soup is bubbling gently in a large pot.
ex.zh: 汤在一口大锅里咕嘟咕嘟地轻轻翻滚。

ex.en: Growing vegetables in pots allows residents with limited outdoor space to produce some of their own food.
ex.zh: 用盆种菜能让户外空间有限的居民自己种出一些食物。

tip: 锅、盆、罐都可用pot；平底煎锅常用pan。

senses.en: Very much; a large amount.

ex.en: Thank you a lot for your help.
ex.zh: 非常感谢你的帮助。

ex.en: I like English a lot.
ex.zh: 我非常喜欢英语。

tip: a lot 常放在动词后面，表示程度；a lot of 后接名词。

senses.en: A soft white food made from soybeans.

ex.en: Mapo tofu is a famous Chinese dish.
ex.zh: 麻婆豆腐是一道有名的中国菜。

ex.en: My grandma often cooks tofu for dinner.
ex.zh: 我奶奶经常做豆腐当晚餐。

senses.en: a tropical bird with a curved beak, sometimes copying speech
to repeat someone's words without understanding or considering them

ex.en: The green parrot cracked a seed with its beak.
ex.zh: 那只绿色鹦鹉用喙啄开了一粒种子。

ex.en: Students who merely parrot their teachers' explanations may struggle to apply knowledge to unfamiliar situations.
ex.zh: 只会机械重复教师讲解的学生，可能难以将知识应用于陌生情境。

col: parrot someone's words｜机械重复某人的话
tip: 作动词常带贬义，强调不加理解或思考地重复。

senses.en: A stringed musical instrument played by plucking or strumming.

ex.en: My sister plays the guitar beside the window every evening.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚上都在窗边弹吉他。

ex.en: Learning to play the guitar can help students develop patience, coordination, and confidence through regular practice.
ex.zh: 学习弹吉他能帮助学生通过规律练习培养耐心、协调能力和自信。

tip: 表示弹吉他，通常说play the guitar。

senses.en: a sport involving hitting a ball over a net with rackets

ex.en: We play tennis at the park on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我们每逢周日都在公园打网球。

ex.en: Providing affordable tennis lessons can encourage young people to exercise regularly and develop greater physical coordination.
ex.zh: 提供价格实惠的网球课程，可以鼓励年轻人经常锻炼并提高身体协调能力。

tip: 说 play tennis，不加冠词；球拍用 racket。

senses.en: One side of a sheet of paper in a book.

ex.en: Please turn to page 20.
ex.zh: 请翻到第20页。

ex.en: This page is about my school.
ex.zh: 这一页讲的是我的学校。

tip: “第几页”说 page + 数字，如 page 20。

senses.en: Used to emphasise something surprising or unexpected.
Flat, regular, or equal in amount or level.
Divisible by two without leaving a remainder.

ex.en: Everyone joined the dance, even our shy uncle.
ex.zh: 大家都加入了舞蹈，连我们害羞的叔叔也不例外。

ex.en: Even small improvements in public transport can make daily travel easier for people with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 即使公共交通只有小幅改善，也能让行动不便者的日常出行更加轻松。

tip: even if表假设“即使”；even though表事实“尽管”。

senses.en: Used informally to greet someone or attract their attention.

ex.en: Hey, you left your umbrella beside the door!
ex.zh: 喂，你把伞落在门边了！

ex.en: Informal greetings such as hey may be inappropriate when students first contact university staff by email.
ex.zh: 学生初次通过电子邮件联系大学教职员工时，使用hey这类非正式问候语可能不太合适。

tip: 适合熟人间打招呼；正式邮件避免使用。

senses.en: To make music with a guitar.

ex.en: My brother can play the guitar.
ex.zh: 我哥哥会弹吉他。

ex.en: She plays the guitar after school.
ex.zh: 她放学后弹吉他。

tip: 弹奏乐器时，乐器前通常加 the，如 play the guitar。

senses.en: Used in polite offers and requests, and to say what will happen.
senses.zh: 想（用于礼貌地邀请或向某人提供某物）；将会

ex.en: Would you like some hot pot?
ex.zh: 你想吃点火锅吗？

ex.en: I would like to know your name.
ex.zh: 我想知道你的名字。

tip: would 常缩写为 ’d，如 I'd = I would。

senses.en: To want to do something; a polite way to say want.

ex.en: I would like to make friends with you.
ex.zh: 我想和你交朋友。

ex.en: Would you like to play ping-pong with us?
ex.zh: 你想和我们一起打乒乓球吗？

tip: would like to do sth. 表示“想做某事”。

senses.en: Facts or details about someone or something

ex.en: The receptionist gave us useful information about local buses.
ex.zh: 接待员向我们提供了有关当地公交车的实用信息。

ex.en: Access to reliable information enables patients to make better decisions about their treatment and long-term health.
ex.zh: 获取可靠信息能帮助患者就治疗和长期健康作出更好的决定。

col: access to information｜信息获取渠道
a piece of information｜一条信息
tip: 不可数：说some information，不说an information。

senses.en: An activity you regularly do for pleasure in your free time

ex.en: Growing herbs on my balcony has become my favourite hobby.
ex.zh: 在阳台种香草已成了我最喜欢的业余爱好。

ex.en: Having a creative hobby can help people manage stress and maintain a healthy balance between work and leisure.
ex.zh: 拥有创造性的业余爱好能帮助人们调节压力，保持工作与休闲之间的健康平衡。

col: take up a hobby｜开始培养一种爱好
a creative hobby｜创造性的业余爱好
pursue a hobby｜从事业余爱好
tip: 可数名词，复数为hobbies；开始一种爱好用take up。

senses.en: About; on the subject of (used in email subjects).
senses.zh: （用于回复电子邮件）关于；事由

ex.en: Re: Our school trip next week.
ex.zh: 事由：我们下周的学校旅行。

ex.en: Write 'Re:' before the subject when you reply to an email.
ex.zh: 回复邮件时，在主题前写上“Re:”。

senses.en: Having the colour of grass and most leaves.
Causing little harm to the environment.
The colour of grass and most leaves.

ex.en: She wore a green jacket to match her shoes.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件绿色夹克来搭配鞋子。

ex.en: Governments can encourage green transport by improving public services and building safer routes for cyclists.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过改善公共服务和修建更安全的自行车道来鼓励绿色出行。

col: go green｜采取环保生活方式
tip: 除颜色外，green常表示环保；形容人还可指缺乏经验。

senses.en: The United Kingdom, a country in Europe.

ex.en: London is the capital of the UK.
ex.zh: 伦敦是英国的首都。

ex.en: Ella is from the UK.
ex.zh: 埃拉来自英国。

tip: UK 是 United Kingdom 的缩写，前常加 the。

senses.en: The United States of America.

ex.en: He lives in the US now.
ex.zh: 他现在住在美国。

ex.en: The US is a big country.
ex.zh: 美国是一个大国。

tip: US 是 United States 的缩写，前常加 the。

senses.en: A common English family name.

ex.en: Mr Smith teaches us maths.
ex.zh: 史密斯先生教我们数学。

ex.en: Her last name is Smith.
ex.zh: 她姓史密斯。

senses.en: A girl's name.

ex.en: Lisa has a cute parrot.
ex.zh: 莉萨有一只可爱的鹦鹉。

ex.en: I sit next to Lisa in class.
ex.zh: 在班里我坐在莉萨旁边。

senses.en: A boy's name.

ex.en: Tom likes hot pot very much.
ex.zh: 汤姆非常喜欢火锅。

ex.en: This is my friend Tom.
ex.zh: 这是我的朋友汤姆。

senses.en: A Chinese dish of soup in a pot, in which you cook meat and vegetables.

ex.en: We eat hot pot on cold days.
ex.zh: 天冷的时候我们吃火锅。

ex.en: Tom likes Sichuan hot pot.
ex.zh: 汤姆喜欢四川火锅。

senses.en: A girl's name.

ex.en: Sally is from Australia.
ex.zh: 萨莉来自澳大利亚。

ex.en: Sally and I are in the same class.
ex.zh: 萨莉和我在同一个班。

senses.en: the hard material forming tree trunks and branches
an area of land covered with trees

ex.en: This little chair is made entirely of solid wood.
ex.zh: 这把小椅子完全由实木制成。

ex.en: Using wood from responsibly managed forests can reduce the environmental impact of constructing new homes.
ex.zh: 使用来自负责任管理的森林的木材，可以减少建造新住宅对环境的影响。

col: a piece of wood｜一块木头
walk in the woods｜在树林中散步
tip: 木材义不可数；树林可说a wood或the woods。

senses.en: A large city in Australia.

ex.en: Sydney is a big city in Australia.
ex.zh: 悉尼是澳大利亚的一座大城市。

ex.en: Pauline is from Sydney.
ex.zh: 保利娜来自悉尼。

senses.en: a country occupying a continent between the Indian and Pacific Oceans

ex.en: My cousin moved to Australia to study marine biology.
ex.zh: 我的表亲搬到澳大利亚学习海洋生物学。

ex.en: Australia attracts international students through its universities, diverse cities, and opportunities to study in English.
ex.zh: 澳大利亚凭借其大学、多元化城市以及英语授课的学习机会吸引国际学生。

col: travel to Australia｜去澳大利亚旅行
study in Australia｜在澳大利亚留学
tip: Australia指澳大利亚；Austria才是奥地利。

senses.en: A famous Sichuan dish of tofu with a spicy sauce.

ex.en: Mapo tofu is hot and delicious.
ex.zh: 麻婆豆腐又辣又好吃。

ex.en: My father can cook Mapo tofu.
ex.zh: 我爸爸会做麻婆豆腐。

senses.en: A famous roast duck dish from Beijing.

ex.en: Beijing roast duck is world-famous.
ex.zh: 北京烤鸭世界闻名。

ex.en: We eat Beijing roast duck with our friends.
ex.zh: 我们和朋友们一起吃北京烤鸭。

senses.en: A country and city in South-East Asia.

ex.en: Singapore is a beautiful country.
ex.zh: 新加坡是一个美丽的国家。

ex.en: His friend lives in Singapore.
ex.zh: 他的朋友住在新加坡。

senses.en: The long wall in the north of China, built long ago.

ex.en: The Great Wall is very long.
ex.zh: 长城非常长。

ex.en: We visit the Great Wall in autumn.
ex.zh: 我们秋天去游览长城。

senses.en: A girl's name.

ex.en: Pauline can speak English and French.
ex.zh: 保利娜会说英语和法语。

ex.en: Pauline sits behind me in class.
ex.zh: 保利娜在班里坐在我后面。

senses.en: A common Chinese family name.

ex.en: Mr Lee is our maths teacher.
ex.zh: 李老师是我们的数学老师。

ex.en: Her family name is Lee.
ex.zh: 她姓李。

senses.en: A name for a girl or a pet.

ex.en: Coco is Emma's friend.
ex.zh: 科科是埃玛的朋友。

ex.en: Coco has a small pet dog.
ex.zh: 科科有一只小宠物狗。

senses.en: The capital city of the United Kingdom.

ex.en: We spent a rainy afternoon exploring London by bus.
ex.zh: 我们在一个下雨的下午乘公交车游览了伦敦。

ex.en: London attracts international students because its universities offer diverse courses and access to extensive cultural resources.
ex.zh: 伦敦吸引着国际学生，因为当地大学提供多样的课程和丰富的文化资源。

tip: 城市名首字母大写；通常不加the。

senses.en: to express, involve, or intend something
unkind or unwilling to share or spend money
the total of several values divided by how many exist

ex.en: I didn't mean to leave you waiting outside.
ex.zh: 我不是故意让你在外面等着的。

ex.en: Higher energy prices may mean that low-income households have less money available for other essential needs.
ex.zh: 能源价格上涨可能意味着低收入家庭可用于其他基本需求的钱会更少。

col: mean to do something｜打算做某事
mean doing something｜意味着做某事
be mean to someone｜对某人刻薄
tip: mean to do是“打算做”；mean doing是“意味着做”。

senses.en: a married man considered in relation to his spouse
to use resources carefully so they last longer

ex.en: Her husband brought her lunch during a busy shift.
ex.zh: 她忙着上班时，丈夫给她送来了午饭。

ex.en: When husbands share household responsibilities equally, both partners have more opportunities to pursue their careers.
ex.zh: 当丈夫平等分担家务时，伴侣双方都有更多机会发展事业。

tip: 作动词时较正式，表示节约使用资源。

senses.en: A flying mammal usually active at night.
An object used to hit the ball in certain sports.
To hit or try to hit a ball with a bat.

ex.en: A bat flew above our garden at dusk.
ex.zh: 黄昏时，一只蝙蝠从我们花园上方飞过。

ex.en: Protecting bat habitats can benefit agriculture because many species feed on insects that damage crops.
ex.zh: 保护蝙蝠栖息地能使农业受益，因为许多蝙蝠以危害农作物的昆虫为食。

tip: 网球拍用racket，棒球棒和板球拍用bat。

senses.en: The small flat paddle used to hit the ball in table tennis.

ex.en: I need a new ping-pong bat.
ex.zh: 我需要一副新的乒乓球拍。

ex.en: He plays ping-pong with a red bat.
ex.zh: 他用一副红色的球拍打乒乓球。

senses.en: To play the game of table tennis.

ex.en: Let's play ping-pong after school.
ex.zh: 我们放学后打乒乓球吧。

ex.en: My sister likes playing ping-pong.
ex.zh: 我姐姐喜欢打乒乓球。

tip: 球类运动前不加 the，如 play ping-pong；乐器前要加 the。

senses.en: with another person or other people
joined or combined with something else

ex.en: We cooked dinner together and shared stories about our day.
ex.zh: 我们一起做晚饭，分享各自一天的见闻。

ex.en: Schools and families should work together to help children develop healthy habits from an early age.
ex.zh: 学校和家庭应共同努力，帮助孩子从小养成健康习惯。

tip: together通常作副词：一起做某事用动词加together。

senses.en: On each day; daily.

ex.en: We have English classes every day.
ex.zh: 我们每天有英语课。

ex.en: She reads English books every day.
ex.zh: 她每天读英语书。

tip: every day 是“每天”；everyday 是形容词“日常的”，注意区分。

senses.en: A long thin pole used for catching fish.

ex.en: My grandfather has a long fishing rod.
ex.zh: 我爷爷有一根长长的钓竿。

ex.en: He takes his fishing rod to the lake.
ex.zh: 他带着钓竿去湖边。

senses.en: to use money to pay for something
to use time doing something or being somewhere

ex.en: We spent all our money on fresh fruit.
ex.zh: 我们把钱全花在了新鲜水果上。

ex.en: Governments should spend more on preventive healthcare to reduce the future costs of treating chronic diseases.
ex.zh: 政府应增加预防保健方面的支出，以减少未来治疗慢性病的费用。

tip: 用spend时间doing或spend钱on；过去式spent。

senses.en: A large number or amount of something.

ex.en: There are lots of books in our library.
ex.zh: 我们图书馆里有许多书。

ex.en: A lot of students like playing basketball.
ex.zh: 许多学生喜欢打篮球。

tip: a lot of 和 lots of 都表示“许多”，后接名词。

senses.en: Used to make an adjective, adverb, or statement stronger.
In fact, rather than only apparently or supposedly.
Used in questions to express surprise or doubt.

ex.en: This soup is really hot, so let it cool.
ex.zh: 这汤非常烫，先让它凉一凉吧。

ex.en: Before expanding online education, policymakers should consider whether digital courses really meet the needs of disadvantaged learners.
ex.zh: 在扩大在线教育之前，政策制定者应考虑数字课程是否真正满足弱势学习者的需求。

tip: not really通常表示“不太”，语气比直接说no缓和。

senses.en: a person who belongs to a group or organisation

ex.en: Each club member brought a dish to share.
ex.zh: 每位俱乐部成员都带了一道菜与大家分享。

ex.en: Every member of a community can contribute to protecting local green spaces through regular volunteer work.
ex.zh: 社区中的每一位成员都可以通过定期参与志愿服务，为保护当地绿地出力。

tip: 表示某团体的成员，用a member of。
